integrity: Analytical proof based on exact Hermite–Laguerre spectrum and the fixed-degree Charlier expansion; numerical and symbolic finite checks are supplementary and not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: All asymptotics hold for fixed Hermite order and fixed positive annulus area as inner radius tends to infinity; paired local maxima must be nondegenerate and have positive height. The global shoulder selection is proved for second-Hermite only. No explicit finite onset radius or unique maximizing lattice index is claimed. Earlier specialized polynomial-maximum expansions could reduce bibliographic novelty.
title: Universal signed shoulder law for thin Hermite-window localization annuli
